name: SPACE MARINES: BLADEGUARD VETERANS
description:
Bladeguard Veterans are inexorable warriors, advancing relentlessly with blades held high – the very image of noble knights of myth. Members of their Chapter’s elite 1st Company of Veterans, each of these vastly experienced Space Marines has fought to preserve the Imperium across countless worlds.

Lead the Charge or Hold the Line

This multipart plastic kit builds 3 Bladeguard Veterans, elite close-combat warriors for your Space Marines armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. Armed with a master-crafted power weapon and equipped with a storm shield, they can cut through even the gravest threats to the Imperium while shrugging off incoming attacks. These grizzled veterans are clad in intricately detailed plate, which looks great in the colours of any Chapter.

Your Veterans, Your Way

Each Bladeguard Veteran has a choice of interchangeable parts and can be built in different poses. One can be built as an optional sergeant, who can upgrade his bolt pistol to a plasma pistol or neo-volkite pistol. There are also options to build narrative poses – pointing and resting a hand on a sword in a scabbard, or wiping a sword clean.

The kit includes these interchangeable parts:
– 4 right-armed master-crafted power swords
– 3 left-armed master-crafted power swords
– 3 heavy bolt pistols
– 1 neo-volkite pistol
– 1 plasma pistol
– 3 storm shields
– 1 sergeant helmet
– 3 helmeted heads
– 3 bare heads
– 6 tilting plates

Contents:
– 78 plastic components
– 3 Citadel 40mm Round Bases
– 1 Ultramarines Infantry Transfer Sheet
– 1 construction guide

The Ultramarines Infantry Transfer Sheet features 299 high-quality waterslide transfers. These include Ultramarines Chapter symbols, battlefield role identification, numerals, and more for you to decorate your miniatures.

These miniatures require assembly and are supplied unpainted. We recommend:
– Citadel Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters
– Warhammer Colour Plastic Glue
– Warhammer Colour paints
